# SnapLink

SnapLink is the ultimate platform for secure file sharing, digital identity, and modern URL shortening. 

## Platform Overview
SnapLink allows professionals to share files securely with auto-destructing links, create stunning 3D digital business cards (vCards), and generate customized bio pages for their brand.
